value.rationale: An exact infinite-family probability polynomial for every k-variable Gödel equation provides a finite all-equation classification of chain-product finite gaps, not just a named identity. It separates generic violations from measure-zero boundary and coincidence witnesses, quantifies an equation-independent positive gap, and determines rational asymptotic limits. Motivated by Bumpus–Kocsis's explicit restricted-Gödel classification direction.
